verdict.rationale: Rollbar's docs say it aggregates Occurrences caused by the same error into Items using a default grouping algorithm. Users can define Custom Fingerprinting Rules when that algorithm splits or combines occurrences wrongly, and can manually merge items into one group. Together these cover both automatic deduplication and the ability to correct grouping. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the default fingerprint is derived from the stack trace, and independent or hands-on corroboration of grouping accuracy at high event volume.
